summary: Full backend + frontend validation for PSC Stock Control fresh-start build. Verified: (a) empty-state — /api/bootstrap, /api/dashboard, /api/stock all return empty; (b) SEED_DEMO_DATA gating — restarted backend, no demo data was re-seeded; (c) masters/product CRUD via API; (d) transactions with movement_date persist, /api/ledger sorts strictly by movement_date desc across three dates (2026-02-05, 2025-06-20, 2025-01-15); (e) PUT /api/transactions updates movement_date; (f) inventory math correct (available=45, inward=55, outward=10); (g) Frontend History page shows date range filter with data-testids, presets, from/to inputs, clear-range button, summary; (h) Stock In modal defaults transaction-date-input to today, accepts backdated date and posts successfully; (i) 'This month' preset correctly hides the backdated 2025-01-15 movement and Clear range restores all rows.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() writes 'seeded' marker with mode='empty' when SEED_DEMO_DATA is unset — good, deploy-safe.
/api/admin/reset resets the seeded marker with reset flag but doesn't drop it, so seed() will not re-run after a reset either. Good.
movement_date is optional in TransactionIn but backend defaults to now()[:10] if missing — sensible fallback; frontend enforces required so users always pick a date.
SearchSelect renders data-testid={testId}-{id} per option — good testability.
App.js is 1255 lines — approaching the 700-line splitting threshold; consider modularising History/TransactionModal/Catalog into separate files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: During UI test, seeded 1 brand, 1 product, 1 supplier, 1 dealer and posted 2 inward movements; DB reset back to empty at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB is empty and SEED_DEMO_DATA unset — backend starts clean on restart. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_stock_flow.py must be run with `python -m pytest -o addopts=''` to disable xdist parallelism (pytest.ini enables it, but this suite uses module-level shared state via a `state` dict and needs serial execution). Otherwise all TestTransactions tests fail due to KeyError on shared state across xdist workers.
